answer: Proposed gate: each ID/day delivers one crystal oscillator to an orchard sensor-network vertex. A depot inspects and retains it, signing its certified serial and ID/day. Validators check the signature and globally unused serial; failure denies listing. Ten IDs surrender ten parts/day: batching shares travel, not parts or credit. Parts are recurring expense; vehicles are reusable capital; no stake. Honest custody and serial certification are essential; depot collusion can fake delivery. Cheap parts weaken deterrence. This prices IDs, not owners.
